title: Re-Ranking News Comments by Constructiveness and Curiosity Significantly Increases Perceived Respect, Trustworthiness, and Interest
reasoning: The paper focuses on the social impact of re-ranking news comments using prosocial classifiers (built with PaLM 2). While it measures outcomes like perceived respect and trustworthiness, it is a social science study on communication norms rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, formal ethics, or moral reasoning systems.
